description: Get estimated realized + unrealized profit & loss for a politician. Methodology: each disclosed trade amount range is converted to an estimated share count using the stock's historical market price on the transaction date, then FIFO-matched on shares (realized = (sellPrice - buyPrice) x matched shares); open positions are marked to the current price for unrealized P&L. Covers Congress (sen-/rep-) and executive branch (exec-) officials, identified by URL slug. Response includes a `totals` object (estimatedRealizedPnl, estimatedUnrealizedPnl, winRate, realizedTrades, tickersTraded) and a `byTicker[]` breakdown (estimatedShares, avgCostBasis, currentPrice, realizedPnl, unrealizedPnl, unrealizedPnlPercent); byTicker open positions double as the estimated holdings. All figures are estimates (±25-40% from disclosure bracket width).

slug.description: Politician URL slug: congressional ("sen-nancy-pelosi", "rep-...") or executive ("exec-trump-donald-j")
